name: Commercial Data License Plate™
alternateName: Naturepedia Governance, Retrieval Rights, and Commercial Data Licensing Plate
headline: Commercial Data License Plate™ — Retrieval, Training, Embedding, Ingestion, Synchronization, Redistribution, and Framework Rights
description: A machine-readable governance and licensing Plate separating endpoint-level x402 retrieval from commercial training, embedding, bulk ingestion, synchronization, redistribution, private-dataset construction, derivative-dataset creation, and Robbie’s Razor framework implementation rights.
conditionsOfAccess: Public discovery is free. An x402 payment grants one endpoint-level retrieval of the identified resource only. Commercial reuse and framework implementation require separate written agreements.
usageInfo: Payment for machine retrieval does not grant training, embedding, bulk-ingestion, redistribution, resale, synchronization, private-dataset construction, derivative-dataset creation, commercial implementation, or framework-implementation rights.

hasPart.name: Endpoint-Level Machine Retrieval
hasPart.description: Class-specific fixed x402 retrieval prices are defined by the authoritative production pricing manifest and convey one retrieval of the identified resource only.

hasPart.name: Commercial Data Reuse Rights
hasPart.description: Training, embedding, commercial ingestion, synchronization, redistribution, and derivative-dataset rights begin at 1,000 USD equivalent and are granted only through a separate written agreement.

hasPart.name: Framework and Strategic Infrastructure Rights
hasPart.description: Robbie’s Razor™, RRIP, Graph Registry™, Plate architecture, deployment, and strategic infrastructure implementation rights require a separate enterprise agreement.
